translated_title: Mexico Sees the US as a 'Greater Threat' Than China or Russia, New Survey Confirms
original_title: México ve a EU como una “mayor amenaza” que China o Rusia, confirma nueva encuesta
author: SinEmbargo Editorial Staff
meta_description: A Focaldata–Rockefeller poll finds 58% of Mexicans see the US as a major threat, more than double the figure for China and well above Russia.
